moment.text: Female figures carrying baskets on their heads are pictured so that Bellange's etchings of gardeners balancing ornate, fanciful containers must have been based on reality.

French etching did not find its style in Paris but, through Callot and Bellange, in the border duchy of Lorraine, where a brilliant provincial court [encouraged] artists shortly before and after 1600.
